high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a document titled "Generative Data Refinement: Just Ask for Better Data." The document appears to be an academic or research paper, authored by Minqi Jiang, João G. M. Araújo, Will Ellsworth, Sian Gooding, and Edward Grefenstette, all affiliated with Google DeepMind. The date at the top right corner indicates it was published in September 2024. The content of the document discusses the challenges of training large models with high-quality data, particularly as the growth rate of training datasets exceeds the rate at which new data is indexed on the web
